# Kristofer Öhman

> CTO at Apohem, a Swedish online pharmacy. Works on applied AI, taking a regulated business from AI First to AI Native, and on AI and cyber oversight from a board perspective. Open to board assignments and advisory roles.

## About

- Now: CTO, Apohem (Swedish online pharmacy, ~1bn SEK, Axel Johnson group); taking it from AI First to AI Native, scaling through automation, not headcount
- Before: CIO, head of tech, operations and engineering, in high-growth and traditional companies; adidas, Klarna (reliability); co-founder through to exit; mentor to four startups
- Focus: applied AI, AI governance, cybersecurity and NIS2, digital transformation in regulated businesses
- Leadership approach: psychological capital (hope, efficacy, resilience, optimism)
